resource.name: ota-channel-service
resource.description: Pushes room rates and availability out to connected OTA channels and pulls channel-made reservations back into the system, keeping inventory consistent everywhere.

suggestions.name: SiteMinder
suggestions.description: A channel-manager hub that connects once and fans out to many OTAs (Booking.com, Expedia, Airbnb, …) through a single API.

suggestions.name: Cloudbeds Channel Manager
suggestions.description: Bundled channel management as part of a wider hotel-commerce platform.

suggestions.name: Booking.com Connectivity API
suggestions.description: Direct integration with a single major OTA; needs one integration per channel added.

suggestions.name: Expedia Partner Central Connectivity API
suggestions.description: Direct integration with Expedia only; needs one integration per channel added.
